authorization: membership visibility AND each feature/field policy; resolver alone is not payroll permission
replay: read; as_of and partial/error semantics explicit

name: 급여 run 생성

inputs: object_type_id, title when required, command_id; params run_id/period_start/period_end/optional connector/job; checklist/four_eyes witnesses only as configured

replay: command_id+payload digest, same actor/action/type/current authority; navigate projected.draft_run_id
gap: native roster source and source provenance adapter; changing correlation run_id per retry creates different natural key

name: 계약급여 원 사실 저장
status: existing REST write, extension needed for stronger contract
authorization: authorize_org_wide PayrollRunManage; employee belongs to armed org; future reference validation at owner
replay: idempotency key not established on this route; response-loss reconciliation required
gap: typed evidence/contract refs; consistent same-date revision and replay protection; avoid duplicating existing wage writer

name: 공식 계산 입력 고정/정정
entry: canonical action extension, path not yet published
owner: existing payroll owner, not import or UI writer
inputs: draft_run_id,expected_input_revision,typed immutable source refs; derived amounts verified server-side
authorization: same tenant/company + manage + evidence-specific authorization; source verification is governed, not client boolean
replay: canonical command receipt; immutable input revision; reject changed payload or stale version
gap: native input manifest→roster→LineCalculationInput; imported and native facts normalize to same typed basis without fake import rows; exact schema migration needs reviewed test candidate

name: 근태 마감
authorization: read/manage gates respectively; execution rechecks current state/roster/period lock
replay: existing state guards; repeated POST may 409; no fabricated shared idempotency claim
gap: new immutable input revision must be bound at owner; source amendment/reopen policy requires explicit extension

name: 급여 계산
status: existing REST calculation; common-action extension candidate
owner: payroll lifecycle calculate_run_in_tx; same writer if canonical wrapper added
inputs: existing bodyless draft_run_id; proposed expected input revision belongs in versioned extension
authorization: current org-wide PayrollRunManage, locked current run state; future common-action policy cannot be bypassed by old route
replay: existing duplicate uses typed 409; canonical create/submit/decide already differ; preserve compatibility intentionally
gap: native sources + checked snapshot + authorization parity across entry paths; long job UI must use persisted job evidence if added

name: 상신
authorization: same permissions and SoD binding across both adapters; CALCULATED and no open exceptions
replay: canonical receipt vs direct REST state guard; documented compatibility convergence
gap: exact snapshot/digest binding and common natural-person policy across every writable adapter

name: 급여안 결정
inputs: draft_run_id,decision APPROVE|REJECT,reason required for REJECT; proposed exact submission revision
authorization: SUBMITTED; current lifecycle compares user UUID; enforce current PRODUCT natural-person SoD across direct and wrapper paths
replay: same command can replay accepted receipt when current authority permits; first projected failure may spend approval
gap: account-level check is not proof of distinct natural people; release unchanged; no copying REJECT into leave law

name: 전사 묶음 실행
status: new behavior required; not an existing group-wide write API
entry: operation request → frozen company/target set → existing authorized child actions
owner: existing durable workflow orchestration if semantics fit; no business SQL in coordinator
inputs: group_id,company_ids,target_ids,action,per-target expected revisions and child command IDs
authorization: membership + current feature + evidence policy per target at execution; request actor never SUPER_ADMIN by convenience
replay: persist operation intent before enqueue; deterministic/persisted child command IDs; recover from receipts and current authorization
gap: durable operation state, policy version/target freeze, per-company errors, queue bounds, compensation rules; workflow reuse must be proven before schema choice
